evidence.quote: If an individual has two different alleles at a specific locus, the individual is heterozygous at that locus
Allele frequency, or the frequency at which alleles are found at any locus of interest
can be calculated using the formula k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of alleles at a particular locus
A Punnett square is simply a grid that graphically represents expected genotypes
A gene pool is the unique set of alleles that could be found by analyzing the DNA from every member of a species or population
approximately 85% of human genetic diversity comes from individuals of the same population

objectives: Define heterozygous, homozygous, and allele frequency
Calculate expected numbers of genotypes and use Punnett squares
Explain gene pools and patterns of human genetic diversity
